en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a corner building on a sloping street. The multi‑storey structure houses a liquor factory and wine shop owned by Karl Kohn, with large German signs along the facade. Early utility poles and surrounding town buildings are visible. The right half of the card is mostly blank for writing, with printed captions in red indicating it is from Karlsbad and refers to the Bahnhof (railway station) area.
